guidelines.detail: same as LRN-008 (The description calls for collecting information and calculating a result, while the reference structure has parallel collection branches synchronized before the calculation. This guideline generalizes that structure and is already captured by learned guideline LRN-008.)

new guideline (The description explicitly says measuring continues when the machine is restarted. The reference models that resumed work as an activity, while the generated start event represents the same work differently; therefore this is an element-choice mistake, not an absent activity. The guideline is broadly worded and does not restate process-specific details.)

same as LRN-067 (The description says measuring continues after a restart, and the reference flow connects the restart activity to the resumed work; that flow is absent from the generated model. This is already captured by learned guideline LRN-067.)

documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description explicitly says the process stops when the machine is disconnected, and the generated disconnection event and end event represent that behavior. FID-01 already requires modeling every stated event and outcome, so this is not a new guideline.)

same as LRN-067 (The description explicitly calls for continuing measurement after restart. The reference models this as an activity (M4), while the generated model instead has a start event with no reference counterpart (X1), so this is an element-choice difference rather than an omitted activity.)

same as LRN-067 (The description requires measuring to continue after a restart. The reference represents that continuation as an activity, while the generated model has an unmatched start event that could represent the same work incorrectly. This guideline is already captured by LRN-067.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple independent activities that must all be completed before a later activity can begin: model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them with a parallel join before the later activity
rules_sent_back.situation: the description requires collecting multiple independent inputs before calculating a result

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that work resumes or continues after an interruption or restart: model the resumed work as an activity in the existing process flow, rather than as a start event representing that work
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that work resumes or continues after an interruption or restart

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a disconnection stops an ongoing process
